rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when the allegation is an accusation made against someone.

example.english: This allegation has no evidence at all.
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 zi2 hung3 jyun4 cyun4 mou5 zing3 geoi3

rows.note: Use this for a claim or assertion when the wording is less explicitly accusatory.

example.english: That allegation that the shop is raising the rent doesn't sound credible to me.
example.traditional: 佢話間舖頭要加租，呢個講法我覺得唔可信。
example.jyutping: keoi5 waa6 gaan1 pou3 tau4 jiu3 gaa1 zou1 ni1 go3 gong2 faat3 ngo5 gok3 dak1 m4 ho2 seon3
